| description = Runs at nearly bard speed. Paths clockwise around the central hill in the section just southwest of Feerrott zone line. Place holder is 'lizardman mystic', NOT "a lizard man mystic". Both Mortificator Syythrak and his ph have a 2 hour respawn. You will know if you got a placeholder "lizardman mystic" if you get a faction hit for [[Allize Taeew]] getting better, and [[Allize Volew]] getting worse.<br>
A second lizardman mystic with the exact name of the place holder will spawn around #9 on the map. This one is not a place holder, and will repop much sooner as another lizardman mystic or a lizard man warrior. This will throw off tracking a bit. The true place holder will only spawn at /loc -540, -1520, which is near #24 on the map.

5/25/22
Killed 16 Mortificator Syythrak before attaining staff. 16 vests in a row, 17th was a staff. Would estimate spawn rate of 15-20% for named.

12/06/2024: Got him on the 8th cycle. 15%-20% could be about right.
